parameters.jsCode: return [{json:{ignored:true, reason:'PR action not allowed', action:$json.action}}];

parameters.command:
=cd {{ $json.repo_path }} && bash -lc '
set +e
if [ -f ./.env.ci ]; then set -a; . ./.env.ci; set +a; fi
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
PR="{{ $json.pr_number }}"
SHA="{{ $json.head_sha }}"
REPO="{{ $json.repo }}"
ACTOR="{{ $json.actor }}"
CHANGED_B64="{{ $json.changed_files_b64 }}"
WORKTREE="/tmp/flowa2-pr-${PR}"
OUT="/tmp/flow_a2_ci_result_${PR}.json"
FETCH_LOG="/tmp/flow_a2_fetch_${PR}.log"
WT_LOG="/tmp/flow_a2_worktree_${PR}.log"
RUN_LOG="/tmp/flow_a2_runner_${PR}.log"
REPO_URL="https://github.com/${REPO}.git"
rm -f "$OUT" "$FETCH_LOG" "$WT_LOG" "$RUN_LOG"
git worktree remove --force "$WORKTREE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
rm -rf "$WORKTREE"
TOKEN_PRESENT=false
if [ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
  TOKEN_PRESENT=true
  BASIC_AUTH="$(printf "x-access-token:%s" "${GITHUB_TOKEN}" | base64 | tr -d "\n\r")"
  git -c http.https://github.com/.extraheader="AUTHORIZATION: basic ${BASIC_AUTH}" fetch --no-tags --depth 1 "$REPO_URL" "$SHA" >"$FETCH_LOG" 2>&1
else
  git fetch --no-tags --depth 1 "$REPO_URL" "$SHA" >"$FETCH_LOG" 2>&1
fi
FETCH_STATUS=$?
if [ $FETCH_STATUS -ne 0 ]; then
  python3 - <<PYERR
import json, pathlib, time
log = pathlib.Path("$FETCH_LOG").read_text(errors="replace") if pathlib.Path("$FETCH_LOG").exists() else ""
print(json.dumps({
  "ci_run_id": f"a2-fetch-fail-{int(time.time())}",
  "started_at": "", "completed_at": "", "duration_seconds": 0,
  "repo": "$REPO", "pr_number": int("$PR" or 0), "head_sha": "$SHA", "actor": "$ACTOR",
  "changed_files": [], "stage_results": [],
  "decision": "fail", "status": "failed", "labels": ["ai-security-ci-fail"],
  "summary": "Flow A2 could not fetch PR head SHA in the local repo workspace",
  "command_error": log[-4000:],
  "diagnostics": {"token_present": "$TOKEN_PRESENT", "repo_url": "$REPO_URL", "fetch_method": "github_basic_extraheader"},
  "fix_hint": "GITHUB_TOKEN was not accepted by git fetch or is unavailable to ExecuteCommand. Verify .env.ci is readable by n8n, token has repo access, and run the git fetch smoke command from the n8n host."
}))
PYERR
  exit 0
fi
TARGET_REF="FETCH_HEAD"
git worktree add --detach "$WORKTREE" "$TARGET_REF" >"$WT_LOG" 2>&1
WT_STATUS=$?
if [ $WT_STATUS -ne 0 ]; then
  python3 - <<PYERR
import json, pathlib, time
log = pathlib.Path("$WT_LOG").read_text(errors="replace") if pathlib.Path("$WT_LOG").exists() else ""
print(json.dumps({
  "ci_run_id": f"a2-worktree-fail-{int(time.time())}",
  "repo": "$REPO", "pr_number": int("$PR" or 0), "head_sha": "$SHA", "actor": "$ACTOR",
  "changed_files": [], "stage_results": [],
  "decision": "fail", "status": "failed", "labels": ["ai-security-ci-fail"],
  "summary": "Flow A2 could not create a temporary git worktree for the PR SHA",
  "command_error": log[-4000:],
  "fix_hint": "Remove stale /tmp/flowa2-pr-${PR} worktree files or check repository permissions."
}))
PYERR
  exit 0
fi
cd "$WORKTREE"
if [ ! -f scripts/ci/run_flow_a2_local_ci.py ]; then
  python3 - <<PYERR
import json, time
print(json.dumps({
  "ci_run_id": f"a2-missing-script-{int(time.time())}",
  "repo": "$REPO", "pr_number": int("$PR" or 0), "head_sha": "$SHA", "actor": "$ACTOR",
  "changed_files": [], "stage_results": [],
  "decision": "fail", "status": "failed", "labels": ["ai-security-ci-fail"],
  "summary": "Flow A2 PR checkout does not contain scripts/ci/run_flow_a2_local_ci.py",
  "command_error": "The PR branch or base commit does not include the Phase 7 CI runner. Rebase the PR branch on current main."
}))
PYERR
  exit 0
fi
python3 scripts/ci/run_flow_a2_local_ci.py --repo-root . --changed-files-b64 "$CHANGED_B64" --pr-number "$PR" --repo "$REPO" --head-sha "$SHA" --actor "$ACTOR" --output-json "$OUT" >"$RUN_LOG" 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT" ]; then
  cat "$OUT"
else
  python3 - <<PYERR
import json, pathlib, time
log = pathlib.Path("$RUN_LOG").read_text(errors="replace") if pathlib.Path("$RUN_LOG").exists() else ""
print(json.dumps({
  "ci_run_id": f"a2-runner-fail-{int(time.time())}",
  "repo": "$REPO", "pr_number": int("$PR" or 0), "head_sha": "$SHA", "actor": "$ACTOR",
  "changed_files": [], "stage_results": [],
  "decision": "fail", "status": "failed", "labels": ["ai-security-ci-fail"],
  "summary": "Flow A2 runner did not create an output JSON file",
  "command_error": log[-4000:],
  "fix_hint": "Run scripts/ci/run_flow_a2_local_ci.py manually inside the temporary worktree to see the failing validator."
}))
PYERR
fi
exit 0
'
